[[File:ClanIlyaSigil-SWMiniaturesBattlesCompanion.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Sigil of Clan Ilya]]
'''Clan Ilya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]] that colonized the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].

Ilya was the smallest of the three, after [[Clan Balya|Balya]] and [[Clan Alya|Alya]], and was chosen for the colonization owing to its galactic business ventures, bringing along their portfolios of business and trade contacts. During the development of the colony, Ilya attracted most of the off-world corporations that came to Kothlis.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Being one of the founding clans, Ilya members could occupy positions in the [[Bothan Colonial Board]] of Kothlis, and one additional member represented the clan.<ref name="guide" />

After most of Alya's population left the planet to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Ilya became the second largest clan on the planet.<ref name="guide" />
